Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a classic AP-MS (Affinity Purification Mass Spectrometry) using HA-tagged proteins. Quantification was performed using spectral counting (label-free). While the biological context discusses acetylation mutations (K258R), the proteomics assay itself was used to identify binding partners, not to map acetylation sites; PRIDE metadata explicitly states 'No PTMs are included in the dataset'.
